action.name: Browser Images to PS
setup.label: Set up PS script
hint.browser_offline: Install and enable the Moni-Connector browser extension, then make sure the browser bridge shows connected in Moni.
hint.ps_setup_required: Failed to install the Photoshop script automatically. Make sure Photoshop is running, or click "Set up PS script" in the action settings to retry.
hint.pick_images: Click the images to collect, press Esc to finish
hint.ps_not_running: Photoshop is not running. Enable "Launch Photoshop automatically" in the action options, or start Photoshop manually.
hint.ps_comm_failed: Photoshop is running but its scripting channel is not responding (a dialog may be open or startup is unfinished). Quit Photoshop and run the action again; the action will start it for you.
error.browser_offline: The browser extension is not connected.
error.ps_unavailable: Photoshop scripting is unavailable. Make sure Photoshop is installed and running.
error.ps_setup_required: The Photoshop script is not installed yet.
error.ps_not_running: Photoshop is not running; the action was aborted.
error.ps_launch_failed: Failed to start Photoshop. Check the installation path.
error.ps_launch_timeout: Timed out waiting for Photoshop to start; the action was aborted.
error.ps_comm_failed: Photoshop does not respond to script commands; the action was aborted.
